scene.head: with_body
scene.custom: User requested front view for style comparison: entire seated body and face front-on, looking into camera.

prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create ONE revised vertical 2:3 illustration, 1024×1536.

INPUT IMAGES: Image 1 is the edit target, the existing full-body everyday roller-rink illustration. Image 2 is the same woman's world card, supplied only to clarify her original face and rendering style from the front.

REQUESTED CHANGE: Replace the side/profile view in image 1 with an unmistakably straight-on FRONT VIEW for a character art-style comparison. She remains seated cross-legged on the rink floor, but her shoulders, torso and pelvis face squarely toward the camera. Her head is upright and faces straight toward the lens, both eyes and both sides of her face clearly visible, nose centred, gaze directly at the viewer. No sideways gaze, profile, three-quarter head turn or over-the-shoulder view. Keep a soft relaxed expression.

PRESERVE: The exact same adult woman, face identity, amber eyes, chestnut hair, haircut/braids, skin tone and natural body proportions. Preserve image 1's blouse, skirt, shoes, their actual colours and materials, small jewellery and roller-rink setting. Keep the same rendering finish, line treatment, dimensional shading, brushwork and material highlights as these references; do not restyle or make her more realistic or more anime. Image 2 contributes only her identity and rendering, never its armour, crown or regalia.

COMPOSITION: Centred full-body long shot at eye level with her seated face. The entire seated figure, both hands and both feet fit inside the frame with generous margins; show the rink environment around her. Keep the cross-legged seated posture, right hand resting naturally on her knee or lap, left palm naturally braced on the floor beside her. Both arms connect naturally at the shoulders. Two human hands, five fingers per hand, with natural joints. Adjust the limbs and camera only as necessary to make the whole pose frontal and anatomically natural. No added props, text, labels, logos, watermark or frame.
